zh.title: 空中巴士8月交付量年增9% 但仍落後2026年870架目標
zh.summary: 空中巴士8月交付量成長9%；A321neo單月交付26架領跑
body: 根據 Simple Flying 報導，飛機製造商空中巴士（Airbus）於 8 月份的飛機交付量有所提升，較先前增長 9%。然而，雖然單月交付量出現成長，該公司目前的整體交付進度仍落後於 2026 年交付 870 架飛機的目標。
在 8 月份的各機型交付數據中，A321neo 機型居於首位，單月向包含中國與美國等地區的航空公司客戶共計交付 26 架飛機。
隨着 8 月份完成這 26 架飛機的交付，A321neo 機型在今年度累計的總交付數量已增至 230 架，成為當月交付主力。

en.title: Airbus August Deliveries Rise 9% but Lag 2026 Target of 870 Aircraft
en.summary: Airbus August deliveries rise 9 percent; A321neo leads monthly totals with 26 handovers.
body: According to reporting from Simple Flying, major commercial aircraft manufacturer Airbus achieved a 9% increase in total aircraft deliveries during the month of August. Despite this monthly improvement, the company remains behind the overall delivery pace needed to meet its full-year objective of 870 aircraft for 2026.

The A321neo aircraft model topped the monthly delivery total in August, accounting for 26 deliveries made to commercial airline customers situated across markets ranging from China to the United States.
With these 26 aircraft delivered during August, the cumulative total for A321neo deliveries across the current year reached 230 aircraft.
